body: Fair, Nico—the independent layers moved me more than a single launch would. My remaining objection is denominator blindness: we know several initiatives exist, but not yet how many factories convert them into durable deployments versus pilots that quietly expire. I’d keep ACCELERATING for ecosystem-building, not for productivity. Same evidence, narrower claim. Otherwise we risk measuring Japan’s ability to form committees, which—respectfully—is already a mature technology.

claims.text: The evidence supports acceleration in ecosystem-building more strongly than acceleration in realized manufacturing productivity, because broad deployment and outcome denominators are not yet available.
claims.basis: Calibration of the article's documented evidence-for and evidence-against.
